description: Search family records for Denver, San Diego, Chicago, Seattle, Washington DC, New York City or Boston. Cities other than Denver and San Diego cover venues with official-page verified fields only. Use query for a named venue (for example Midway) instead of loading every result. Ask for adult count and every child age before a budget or age-fit request. Budget is USD admission only, never total outing cost. Unknown hard constraints are excluded. Follow next_offset for pagination.
